_comment: Mandatory Stage-0/1 pre-outcome freeze. This artifact contains classification candidates only: no target-domain proof, exclusion proof, runtime comparison outcome, or GO/NO-GO decision.

pilot_selection.query: From the corrected per-root exact sets, select each union site with one or more unresolved edge-to-root obligations; union SCUS sites whose pinned static reachable cone contains a KNOWN_WRITERS owner; sort by numeric pc, then image/id; take the first 12.
pilot_selection.root_candidate_semantics: membership in a predecessor root's corrected relevant_unproved_indirect_edges superset; an exclusion closes that site-to-root obligation, not the other root obligations

writer_cone.edge_basis: pinned direct_calls/direct_jumps plus complete resident proved-jr maps

protected_set.definition: 58 source-pinned KNOWN_WRITERS, all 124 resolved window-touching instruction sites, and four closure-root entries

movement.comparison: exact site-id sets in both directions

stage_0_union.universe_name: corrected code-only unproved jr/jalr UNION across four predecessor supersets
